meta.title: A closed RFQ: "Increase Event Time": "Cancel" closes it and changes nothing
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

resolved: “Directly compare the event's exact bidding start and end timestamps before and after cancellation.” — remember + expect_remembered compare a value across elements, screens or portals (as numbers with as/delta); expect_api_value compares with the API

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ instead of creating or searching for another event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Keep post-expiry surrogate bidding disabled for the closed RFQ.
Apply the case's buyer bid-edit configuration.
Open the RFQ stage named in the case.
Reach the Responses tab where the buyer opens Settings.
Open the Increase Event Time window from the RFQ Settings menu.
Verify that the requested time-extension window opened.
Cancel the time extension without applying a change.
Verify that cancelling closes the Increase Event Time window.
Verify that the RFQ remains closed after cancellation.
Verify that the existing bidder remains present.
Verify that the existing bid remains unchanged.
Verify that cancelling left the event screen without errors or rendering artifacts.
